summary.text: Dragon Whale Paradise is the blue dragon whale's grotto-heaven, transformed by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable into a paradise without calamities and tribulations.

claims.text: Miao Ming Shen concludes that the explorers have entered the immortal aperture world of the blue dragon whale. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable subdued the blue dragon whale, awakened its immortal aperture, and left a Paradise Earth true inheritance in that grotto-heaven. The Merit Obelisk, a rank eight Immortal Gu House, works across the whole grotto-heaven: outside Gu Immortals must complete its missions for merits to exchange for the true inheritance, or stay on the starting island unable to reach other places. Stay time is three hundred days by the dragon whale grotto-heaven’s time.

The Merit Obelisk states that island resources were arranged by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable so Gu Immortals who refuse missions still gain some rewards. Fang Yuan judges the Obelisk the core of the entire grotto-heaven after it transports him with no effort despite his rank eight cultivation.

Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable left many paradises in the five regions and two heavens; a paradise’s most distinct trait is the lack of calamities and tribulations. The dragon whale grotto-heaven was transformed by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable into a paradise, matching the village records Fang Yuan soul-searches. Distance control keeps other islands forever out of reach, a signature Paradise Earth method.
Future self lets Fang Yuan mimic Fixed Immortal Travel across the five regions and two heavens, but he still cannot enter places like the dragon whale paradise.

Inside Dragon Whale Paradise, Gu Immortals treat paradise restrictions as temporary protection that keeps Shen Cong Sheng from freely attacking rivals. The Merit Obelisk limits the stay to three hundred days before transport out. Information path methods are greatly restricted. Shen Cong Sheng stakes Shen clan reputation rather than a formal agreement when seeking cooperation there.

Fang Yuan notes many changes in Dragon Whale Paradise compared with his previous life: the blue dragon whale’s location, the Gu Immortal count, and the missions all differ. He intends to take down Dragon Whale Paradise, with regret Gu only part of a larger plan, and draws on prior-life collective findings about the Merit Obelisk and blue dragon whale.

Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable’s method still restricts Fang Yuan inside Dragon Whale Paradise: he cannot release sovereign immortal aperture subordinates, and he cannot attack Shen Cong Sheng, Miao Ming Shen, or Ren Xiu Ping, lest exposed methods leave with them.
